command_runs: Trusted static_analysis measure, bound by the host policy: bounded repository static inspection of the additive ARGUS2 scope (python ast parse of every candidate src/xverse/argus module plus the owned tests/thesis_lite/argus modules without writes, the frozen diagnostic catalogue and canonical-serialization flag checks, the terminal-review repair checks for pre-I/O path confinement, bounded reads, manifest publication byte bound and admission snapshot isolation, and an additive-diff scope check proving that accepted XDL, C++ X-COM, legacy/compat/blueprint sources and all historical records are unchanged). No static analysis is executed by this stage.
note: The 18 identifiers are exactly the declared static_checks of the ARGUS2-SR-001-U..012-U unit records (12 base checks plus the 6 additive terminal-review repair checks ARGUS2-SR-001-U-STATIC-SNAPSHOT, ARGUS2-SR-002-U-STATIC-PUBLISH, ARGUS2-SR-005-U-STATIC-DIAGNOSTICS, ARGUS2-SR-006-U-STATIC-READBOUND, ARGUS2-SR-007-U-STATIC-CONFINE and ARGUS2-SR-010-U-STATIC-CONFINE), each bound here by an analyzed_by trace link. The static_analysis measure declares structural checks rather than pytest-discovered cases, so these identifiers are declaration-bound static rules and are not required to appear as collected tests; no static analysis runs in this stage. The checks parse all candidate src Python plus the owned tests without writes and require no pytest output.
title: ARGUS2 repository static analysis of the additive evidence package, repair hardening, diagnostics and wheel composition
